rootCause: Whole-sidecar parsing and early metadata exceptions prevented independent deterministic checks from running. A bounded revision therefore received an incomplete initial issue list.
changes: Keep the existing strict whole-handoff schema and strict runtime consumer parsing. For diagnostics only, reuse individual field schemas when whole-handoff parsing fails.

Continue checks on independently valid fields/tables; leave malformed tables unavailable and explicitly report checks requiring them as not run. Do not coerce data, fabricate empty valid registries or guess invalid row contents.
Report version/header, inline handoff and retained calculation failures without masking other independently readable sidecar checks.
Distinguish unavailable producer outputs from genuinely absent delivered outputs. Attribute uncheckable references to the producer, avoiding unsupported consumer repair grants.
Keep invalid documents blocked and retain the existing one grouped revision plus targeted verification. No additional automatic retries, roles, schemas or author prompt rules.

generalization.fixtures: Independent synthetic handoffs, not paid-project products or human-revised copies. New cases cover multiple document roles, metadata barriers, dependent tables and producer/consumer references.
generalization.granularity: Whole field/table. Invalid tables explicitly require correction before their internal relationships can be checked; this is not a claim of exhaustive diagnostics over malformed rows.

verification.initialReproduction: Six new synthetic diagnostic tests failed before the system change.

regression.skipReason: Existing browser-dependent design inspection test; no real browser/runtime acceptance was performed.

hostIntegration: Multiple independent diagnostics are available together through the existing projectDesignReleaseDiagnostics consumed by Review/Revision.
A complete versioned synthetic correction advances inspect -> revise -> verify -> next author stage.
A format-only correction remains blocked after the single revision; no relaunch or baseline release.
An unparseable producer output registry does not grant edits to its otherwise valid consumer.

readonlyPreviousPaidProductCheck.observation: The unchanged saved v1.1 Audio product still has its missing event producer and wrong resolution owner. The system repair does not silently repair or release previous products.

boundaries.remainingAcceptance: A separately authorized fresh-idea native paid run is needed to evaluate actual author/reviewer revision behavior. Passing offline checks does not establish full game/document delivery quality.
